item.description: A new survey shows half of senior doctors in Queensland are concerned fatigue could contribute to a clinical error, and almost a quarter anticipate quitting in the next two years.

item.title: ABC News: Live: Another headache for Labor as Greens weigh up CGT alternative
item.description: The Greens are entertaining the idea of backing a plan by independent MP Allegra Spender to overhaul Labor's capital gains tax discount changes. Follow live.

item.title: ABC News: Lindsay Clancy to face retrial in March
item.description: A Massachusetts judge schedules Lindsay Clancy's retrial for late March, with lawyers to discuss trial logistics and media arrangements in late December.

item.title: ABC News: Conditions imposed on surgeon years after Qld grandmother's death
item.description: The Medical Board of Australia delivers its findings against surgeon Stefaan De Clercq after his patient, Joanne Downie, died at Bundaberg Hospital in October 2023.

item.title: ABC News: Trump says Huang could return to Nvidia
item.description: Donald Trump adds weight to a push to reinstate former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, just a few days after his resignation amid fears he had been in a relationship with a Chinese spy.

item.title: ABC News: Popovic admits Socceroos future uncertain after Asian Cup postponement
item.description: Tony Popovic hopes this week's clash with Jordan is not his last in charge of the Socceroos, but admits he is yet to hold contract talks with FA.

item.title: ABC News: Nearly 4,000 Tasmanians waiting for urgent endoscopy
item.description: Nearly 4,000 Tasmanians are on the public health wait list for an urgent endoscopy.

item.title: ABC News: With each new 007 comes a reinvention for the 64-year-old franchise
item.description: The announcement of a new actor to play James Bond gives the franchise an opportunity to reinvent itself for a new audience.

item.title: ABC News: Arrest over Melbourne Cup theft but trophies still missing
item.description: A man has been arrested and released pending summons after three Melbourne Cup trophies won by Makybe Diva were stolen from Flemington on Monday.

item.title: ABC News: Yemen's pro-government forces retreat to defend key port city of Aden
item.description: The Saudi-backed forces have been locked in fierce battles with the Iranian-backed Houthis along a mountain range overlooking the Bab el-Mandeb Strait.

item.title: ABC News: Where you go to school might impact whether you're drafted to the AFL
item.description: An ABC News analysis of the last 10 AFL national drafts show nearly three quarters of South Australian recruits are privately educated, but one public school is bucking the trend.

item.title: ABC News: Buying food on Facebook legally 'murky', expert says
item.description: Facebook Marketplace is full of ads for everything from pre-batched curries to trays of baked goods. The prices are enticing, but a food safety expert says buyers are taking a massive risk with their health and their money.

item.title: ABC News: UK investigating Russell Brand's message from behind bars
item.description: In a video uploaded to YouTube, his wife Laura Brand reads a statement in which her husband maintains his innocence.

item.title: ABC News: Disadvantaged boys most likely to be funnelled away from NDIS: research
item.description: New research has shed further light on the demographic cohort likely to be funnelled away from the NDIS and onto the new Thriving Kids program.
